reviews.author: Yvette
reviews.message: I bought this for my scars from a double mastectomy. I had tried several “scar products” but none seemed to keep them moisturized so they didnt pull or hurt. I tried this on a whim when ordering the over 60 balm. I was thrilled. Not only does it keep my scars moisturized, they have healed in a way I wasn’t expecting and aren’t “angry” like they were for months after my surgery. My most recent purchase was for my daughter. I was visiting for the holidays and she tried it on cat scratches from their kitten. She was surprised and pleased on how well it worked. Like me she is sensitive to products, especially ones with artificial ingredients. This balm is all natural and if lanolin is a problem for you, this is perfect because it has none. So I am totally confident this is a perfect cream for a variety of uses, not just stretch marks.

reviews.author: Erika M.
reviews.title: THE BEST BALM
reviews.message: I don’t write many reviews because I’m not good with words but this stuff is literally the best balm out there especially for the pregnant bellies! I wish I would’ve known about this brand with my first pregnancy because I was pretty petite and even when I used otc creams and body oils, my skin stretched so much and was so itchy that I got a ton of stretch marks on my sides and below my belly. I also did not know my chest area would grow so much, so I got stretch marks in that area as well. This pregnancy, I’ve been using this balm and the belly serum mostly when I feel my skin is getting tight or if I feel like I need some moisturizing and I haven’t noticed any new stretch marks and the ones from my first pregnancy seem to have faded a tad bit. I also notice this pregnancy my belly is not as itchy as it was the first time around not sure if it’s because my skin is already stretched out but either way this balm helps with the itch and just keeps you nice and moisturized. I wish the jar was a little bigger like the sleepy body lotion because It’s great for your whole body but I do gotta say, a little goes a long way! I would recommend this product to anyone who wants moisturized soft supple skin. If you read this review or any of the other great reviews for this product, buy this stuff if you can! you will not be disappointed.
